name: Lens Flare
description: A bright light sweeps across the frame and flares the lens: a long thin horizontal streak, a glowing core and a trail of colored ghost reflections; at its peak the second clip spreads out from the light under its glare. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: angle
params.description: Angle of the path of the light, in degrees (0 sweeps from left to right)

params.name: height
params.description: How far above the center of the frame the light passes

params.name: color
params.description: Color of the streak and of the glare
